usage: This is the standard, everyday way to say 'I love you' in Cairo. It is used romantically between partners, but equally often platonically among friends, siblings, and parents to children. It is casual and ubiquitous, not reserved only for grand romantic confessions.

variants.label: to a man
variants.note: The standard form when speaking to a male.

variants.label: to a woman
variants.note: The standard form when speaking to a female, differing only in the final vowel.

variants.label: to a group
variants.note: Used when addressing two or more people.

variants.label: intense (to a man)
variants.note: A very common dramatic expression of deep love or extreme fondness.

responses.english: And I love you too (to a man)
May God keep you for me

examples.english: I love you so much, my friend.
I love you too, my love (to a woman).
I love you guys so much, thanks for the surprise.
